summary: Li, Horns et al. 2017 (Cell), Smart-seq2 of FACS-sorted Drosophila olfactory projection neurons (GEO GSE100058), curated before Xie et al. 2021, which reuses its 24 h APF GH146 cells; not previously in VFB. 10 Samples (one per sort: 5 GH146 sorts at 24 h APF; Mz19 at 24, 36, 48, 72 h APF and adult) with 29 Smart-seq2 plate Assays, linked to their GAL4 driver alleles (GENO has_genotype). Six Clusterings: the authors' GH146 24 h HDBSCAN clusters (from their repository; the paper's decoded clusters linked by the authors' own criteria) and the Mz19 developmental series (per-type, per-stage lists). 45 entries: 22 loaded (mature PN type terms from 48 h APF; the 24 h / 36 h types under the stage-neutral PN class of their lineage until FBbt #2220 adds immature / remodelling terms). Summary expression as CPM from GEO's raw HTSeq counts (14,457 genes x 1,379 cells).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.
Curate Li 2017 before Xie 2021, which reuses its 24 h APF GH146 cells (curate the source study first).
Load the GH146 24 h clusters and the Mz19 developmental series; not the astrocyte / C155 controls (not clustered).

Link the paper's decoded GH146 clusters (figure labels #1-#6') to the authors' HDBSCAN clusters by the authors' own criteria (driver cells mapped onto the clusters with a random forest on their ICIM genes, and the defining markers): this uses author definitions, not our own reading.
Swap the authors' two adult Mz19 lists back: the paper defines DA1 PNs as Mz19+/acj6- and VA1d / DC3 as Mz19+/acj6+, the pupal lists follow this, but the adult files are reversed in acj6 / fru.

Immature terms up to the pupal stage (24, 36 h APF), mature from the pharate adult stage; FBbt has no immature projection neuron terms, so the 24 h / 36 h types are held until it does, the request to be made together with Xie 2021's types.

Stages by the Bainbridge & Bownes FBdv definitions; tissue brain to the pupal stage, adult brain from the pharate adult stage; samples from crosses link the GAL4 alleles FlyBase curated for the paper (genotype_includes), the UAS-mCD8GFP reporter left unlinked.

Samples by build_samples.py from GEO (one GSM per cell, titled '<driver> [<library>]') and the authors' library table: one Sample per sort (experiment x driver / stage label), one Assay per Smart-seq2 plate (the pooled library where no plate is recorded).

Clusters by build_clusters.py from the authors' repository files; decoded GH146 clusters from config (match_clusters.py: 91G04 -> 22; Mz19 DA1 -> 8, 5; VA1d -> 7; DC3 -> 12; trol+ NP5103 -> 2; the remaining acj6-/CG31676+ 20, 21 = DL3); the 22 undecoded clusters held (untyped), the unclustered cells held (unassigned). Type mappings by write_type_mappings.py (no judgement needed).
Expression from GEO's raw HTSeq counts (export_counts.py: the loaded cells, spike-ins dropped), CPM over each cell's own counts, extent > 0.2; r6.10 FBgn ids mapped to current FlyBase genes.
All 8 mapped clusters reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`).

FBbt term request opened for the pupal (immature, or remodelling for embryonic-born PNs) PN types, with Xie 2021's (FlyBase/drosophila-anatomy-developmental-ontology#2220); meanwhile the 24 h / 36 h types map to the stage-neutral PN class of their lineage (antennal lobe projection neuron adPN; ... of ALl1 lineage), broad: 14 more clusters loaded.
